events.title: Christmas Market — Spetchley Park Gardens
events.body: Spetchley Park Gardens will host a free Christmas market on 14 and 15 November, with a mix of indoor and outdoor stalls.

news.title: Worcestershire stockpiles salt for winter gritting
news.body: Worcestershire is stockpiling 17,000 tonnes of salt and has a fleet of 36 gritters ready as highways bosses prepare for winter storms.

news.title: Worcestershire County Council faces £85m budget gap
news.body: Worcestershire County Council has begun setting its 2027/28 budget, warning of tough choices ahead as it works to close an £85m funding gap.

notices.title: Police appeal after night burglaries in Inkberrow area
notices.body: Police have issued an appeal for information following a series of burglaries in Inkberrow and Bradley Green, in which windows were smashed to gain entry overnight.
